title: Exact conserved free first-charge-lift energy and invariant phase domain

lift.phase_domain: Qphi in H1 intersect L2(D(Q)); Qpi in L2
lift.conservation: E_Q(t)=E_Q(0) mode by mode and by spectral calculus
lift.topology_control: E_Q controls the K1372 spatial mixed norm and the missing charged momentum
lift.boundary: this is the exact first free charge lift; it requires Q^2phi and Qpi and is not supplied by K1366 base energy
